scenarios.scenario: Align the model browser and viewport to the workspace frame

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
the model browser is docked at the left
the user inspects the workspace boundaries
the model browser begins at the left content edge directly below the ribbon
the viewport begins at the browser's shared divider without an empty gutter
the viewport fills the remaining content width
the ribbon, browser, viewport and status area use aligned outer edges

scenarios.scenario: Use consistent spacing within and between workspace regions

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
the ribbon, model browser, viewport, document tabs and status area are visible
the user inspects the spacing between workspace regions and their controls
adjacent workspace regions share their intended borders without stray gutters
controls within each region use a consistent inset from that region's border
the ribbon command groups use even spacing between neighboring groups
the browser, viewport, document tabs and status area align to their shared edges
no region has an unexplained extra margin or padding

scenarios.scenario: Align the document tabs with the viewport instead of the browser

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
the model browser is docked at the left
the user inspects the bottom workspace rows
the browser extends to the status area above the bottom row
the document tab strip begins at the viewport's left edge
the document tab strip ends at the viewport's right edge
no document tabs appear below the model browser
the status area spans the full application width

scenarios.scenario: Close and restore the drawing browser from its tab area

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-drawing.odd` is active in the MCAD Software
its model browser is docked on the left
the user selects the browser tab's close control
the browser tree is hidden
the drawing occupies the space previously used by the browser
a plus control remains at the upper left of the workspace
the user opens the plus control
the panel list offers Model Browser
the user selects Model Browser
the browser returns to the left
it displays the drawing resources and sheet tree

scenarios.scenario: Close and restore the model browser while editing a sketch

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
Sketch1 is being edited
the model browser is docked on the left
the user selects the browser tab's close control
the model browser is hidden
the sketch viewport extends into the freed space
a panel-add control remains at the upper left of the workspace
the user opens the panel-add control
the panel list offers Model Browser
the user selects Model Browser
the model browser returns to the left
the browser tree and sketch viewport remain visible
